purpose: Updated offline two-car matched comparison. Factor weights and configurations frozen before new calibration/dynamic fit results. Historical raw and Car2-only results are already known.
backend: Two copies of the merged single-car SE(2) residual definitions plus one optional reciprocal-aggregated peer factor per state time. Full-bag batch, not causal replay or fixed lag.

optimizer.initialization: aligned Odom; same initial states for independent and joint

time_association.axis: common bag receipt time, not unsynchronized headers
time_association.keyframe_grid: integer seconds 1 through floor(bag duration)-1, inherited from historical two-car graph
time_association.odom_interpolation: received-time interpolation; require brackets, no extrapolation
time_association.peer_policy: each direction median separately, average available directions into ONE factor; keep sigma .2m, do not treat directions as independent constraints

car1.method: whole-static-bag per-link raw median minus surveyed 3D distance; no dynamic endpoints

car2.method: reuse frozen Oct17 P1 offsets, unchanged from merged single-car model

calibration.peer: no correction fitted; known spatially varying peer/reference discrepancies remain diagnostics
calibration.transfer_status: installation-specific provisional range corrections, not universal hardware calibration

static_validation.source: user confirmation P07; continuation of L endpoint, not newly surveyed

cases.heading_source: unchanged historical two-car placement hypotheses; not independently surveyed
unchanged historical two-car placement hypotheses; not independently surveyed
provisional placement directions from historical session reconstruction, not derived from endpoints

configurations.role: synthetic complete wall-measurement loss, not recorded NLOS
synthetic complete wall-measurement loss, not recorded NLOS
peer-bin association sensitivity, not a full clock calibration
peer-bin association sensitivity, not a full clock calibration

evaluation_only.endpoint_window: last five valid keyframes, inherited from archived two-car comparison; verify stationary Odom support
evaluation_only.primary_effect: per-car joint minus independent endpoint difference; negative means smaller difference
evaluation_only.stationary_metrics: path/net displacement relative to stationary note and recorded Odom; no hard stationary pose constraint
evaluation_only.peer_fitted_residual: consistency diagnostic only, not independent accuracy evidence

assumptions: Both Car1 and Car2 odom reference points are conditionally treated as approximate surveyed chassis centers; not yet verified.
Initial headings are placement hypotheses, not angles inferred from the measured endpoint.
All data are historical/development data; no blind-test claim.
The two methods in each configuration share identical calibration, Odom, wall observations, priors, initial states and solver settings; only the joint method adds peer factors.
No peer/reference adjustment or dynamic endpoint fitting.
Reciprocal directions may be correlated and asynchronous; one aggregate factor does not prove synchronized acquisition.
Static reference uncertainty is not quantified; range spread does not include survey or spatial-transfer uncertainty.
Full-bag results are offline smoothing, not published online estimates or hard-real-time performance.
